outputs: Generated additional sentences and textual explanations describing how the temporal relation between event pairs shifts

Correct answer is 'No' - while LLMs (GPT-3.5) are used to generate explanations, they are not used as judges/evaluators of the generated outputs after generation.

guideline: Human annotators evaluated faithfulness (whether additional sentence makes temporal relation 'more' toward target relation) and plausibility (whether explanation supports why the shift occurs) using binary judgments
